source.citation: M. V. Malyshev, V. M. Donnelly, A. Kornblit, and N. A. Ciampa, Journal of Applied Physics 84, 137-146 (1998)

measurement.conversion: measured along a line 1.35 cm above wafer/chuck; converted assuming radial symmetry and axial sin(pi*h/gap)

digitization.method: native one-bit figure raster; original-resolution human-vision marker reconciliation; PIL axis and point replay

exclusions.low_power_panel_b_overlap: open-circle and filled-square identities merge in the one-bit raster and were omitted
exclusions.unreported_pressure_series_panel_b: 0.5 and 1 mTorr are absent from panel b

use_boundary.interpolation_rule: interpolate only within a fixed gap and pressure series; report interpolation separately from measurement
